pieces.title: Aurora
pieces.description: Green-to-violet aurora curtains with shimmering rays over a dark starry sky.

pieces.title: Dandelion Drift
pieces.description: A dandelion clock sways; seeds let go one by one and sail right on a breeze while the head regrows them.

pieces.title: Fern Unfurling
pieces.description: Fiddleheads uncoil into arching fronds; every leaflet unrolls from its own curl, lime deepening to fern green.

pieces.title: Fireflies
pieces.description: Fireflies drift and blink over a dark meadow under a few stars.

pieces.title: Flow Silk
pieces.description: Fine mint and lime threads drifting through a slowly turning flow field, each trail fading behind it.

pieces.title: Warm breath
pieces.description: A warm seam of light across the clip, slowly breathing in and out; very low power.

pieces.title: Hearts
pieces.description: A few pastel hearts float up with a gentle sway and fade away.

pieces.title: Jade Lava
pieces.description: Slow emerald metaballs merging and parting; cores glow mint where they touch.

pieces.title: Lissajous Comet
pieces.description: A point of light traces a slowly turning 3:2 Lissajous knot; its ink cools from gold to teal and fades.

pieces.title: Murmuration
pieces.description: Hundreds of tiny white birds fold, thin out and thicken as one flock, drifting in a slow figure of eight.

pieces.title: Pixel cat
pieces.description: A tiny ginger pixel cat trots across a pixel night under a crescent moon.

pieces.title: Reaction Mitosis
pieces.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion: one seed divides into a colony that spreads to the edges of the screen, then rewinds to the seed and grows again.

pieces.title: Sakura
pieces.description: Cherry-blossom petals and a few whole blossoms tumble diagonally on the breeze.

pieces.title: Three Sprouts
pieces.description: In a cut-away of dark soil three seeds crack, root, hook up, open seed leaves and unfold their first true leaves.

pieces.title: Starfield
pieces.description: Slow parallax starfield, gentle twinkle, one shooting star per loop.

pieces.title: Cherries
pieces.description: A big glossy pair of cherries drawn from simple shapes.

pieces.title: Art déco
pieces.description: Art-Deco scallop pattern of concentric gold fans.

pieces.title: Sunflower Bloom
pieces.description: A green bud parts, golden petals unfold and florets spiral in at the golden angle; then it gently closes.

pieces.title: Climbing Vine
pieces.description: A vine feels its way across the screen; leaves unfold node by node, tendrils coil, peach blossoms open.

pieces.title: Wave lines
pieces.description: Thin orange and amber sine lines flowing across the clip.
